input.subject: Reviewing our supplier contract — pricing no longer works
input.body: Hi, a competitor just quoted us about 15% less per pallet and we're reviewing our supplier contracts. Unless there's some flexibility on pallet pricing we may switch when this term is up. Can someone walk me through our options?
